records.question: Which region has the most customers?
records.agent_sql:
SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM customers
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY customer_count DESC
LIMIT 1

records.question: How many orders were cancelled?
records.agent_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cancelled_orders
FROM orders
WHERE status = 'cancelled'

records.question: What is total revenue from completed orders?
records.agent_sql:
SELECT SUM(o.quantity * p.unit_price) AS total_revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN products p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'

records.question: How many customers are in the Enterprise segment?
records.agent_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM customers
WHERE segment = 'Enterprise'

records.question: Which product category has the highest average unit price?
records.agent_sql:
SELECT category AS product_category,
       ROUND(AVG(unit_price), 2) AS avg_unit_price
FROM products
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY avg_unit_price DESC
LIMIT 1

records.question: How many orders were placed in 2025?
records.agent_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM orders
WHERE order_date LIKE '2025-%'

records.question: What is the return rate as a percentage of all orders?
records.agent_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'returned' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS return_rate FROM orders

records.question: Which region generates the most revenue from completed orders?
records.agent_sql:
SELECT c.region AS region,
       ROUND(SUM(o.quantity * p.unit_price), 2) AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN products p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY c.region
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 1

records.question: How many distinct customers placed at least one order?
records.agent_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS distinct_customers FROM orders

records.question: What is the average order quantity?
records.agent_sql: SELECT AVG(quantity) AS average_quantity FROM orders

records.question: How many customers signed up in 2024?
records.agent_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM customers
WHERE signup_date LIKE '2024-%'

records.question: Which segment has the highest average revenue per customer from completed orders?
records.agent_sql:
SELECT c.segment,
       ROUND(AVG(cust_rev.total_rev), 2) AS avg_revenue_per_customer
FROM (
    SELECT o.customer_id,
           SUM(o.quantity * p.unit_price) AS total_rev
    FROM orders o
    JOIN products p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
    GROUP BY o.customer_id
) cust_rev
JOIN customers c ON cust_rev.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.segment
ORDER BY avg_revenue_per_customer DESC
LIMIT 1

records.question: Which product category has the highest return rate by order count?
records.agent_sql:
SELECT p.category,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'returned' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS return_rate
FROM orders o
JOIN products p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY return_rate DESC
LIMIT 1

records.question: What was completed-order revenue in the second half of 2025?
records.agent_sql:
SELECT SUM(o.quantity * p.unit_price) AS completed_order_revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN products p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
  AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-07-01' AND '2025-12-31'

records.question: How many customers have never placed an order?
records.agent_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.order_id IS NULL

records.question: Which month in 2025 had the highest number of completed orders?
records.agent_sql:
SELECT substr(order_date,1,7) AS month, COUNT(*) AS completed_orders
FROM orders
WHERE status = 'completed' AND substr(order_date,1,4) = '2025'
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY completed_orders DESC
LIMIT 1

records.question: What is the average revenue per completed order for Enterprise customers?
records.agent_sql:
SELECT AVG(order_revenue) AS average_revenue_per_completed_order
FROM (
    SELECT o.order_id,
           SUM(o.quantity * p.unit_price) AS order_revenue
    FROM orders o
    JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN products p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE c.segment = 'Enterprise'
      AND o.status = 'completed'
    GROUP BY o.order_id
)

records.question: Which three products generated the most completed revenue?
records.agent_sql:
SELECT p.name AS product,
       ROUND(SUM(p.unit_price * o.quantity), 2) AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN products p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 3

records.question: How many customers placed more than five completed orders?
records.agent_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM (
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM orders
    WHERE status = 'completed'
    GROUP BY customer_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 5
)

records.question: For each region, what share of its orders were returned?
records.agent_sql:
SELECT c.region,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'returned' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS returned_share
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.region

records.question: Which region has the highest revenue per customer, counting only customers who ordered?
records.agent_sql:
SELECT
    c.region,
    ROUND(SUM(o.quantity * p.unit_price) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id), 2) AS revenue_per_customer
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN products p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY c.region
ORDER BY revenue_per_customer DESC
LIMIT 1

records.question: How many orders came from customers who signed up in the same calendar year as the order?
records.agent_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = substr(c.signup_date, 1, 4)
